correctness.rationale: For a smooth nonhyperelliptic genus-three plane quartic in characteristic unequal to two, odd quadratic refinements q_(a,b) with a·b=1 label the 28 bitangents and nonzero 2-torsion vectors the 63 Steiner complexes. The incidence condition q(v)=0 yields a 28×63 integer matrix. Independently reconstructed it: MM^T=16I+11J; exact SymPy Smith form has 1^7,2^14,4^6,12, Hermite index 805306368, and every HNF inverse basis-column denominator lcm is 12. These independent calculations check the actual critical integer certificate beyond simply trusting verify_smith.py/verify_hnf.py; the script source was inspected. Sp(6,2)-transitivity and generation of the cokernel force every basis class to have the same order equal to group exponent 12. The geometric label is a standard result and applies over algebraic closure; no k-rational bitangent claim.
